gen-luckiest-guy-gf-arsenal-sc: Arsenal SC sets tightly fitted plain sans letters with a faint but real thick-thin shift. Arsenal SC does the tidy, close-fitted reading work, while Luckiest Guy, steady as a technical pen, does the cheerful shouting.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-asimovian: Loud and cheerful: Luckiest Guy pours its ink at one width beneath a high-set mean line. Asimovian, a sans with tall-bodied letters and one stroke width, does the approachable talking afterward.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-basic: Luckiest Guy is cheerful and loud, its curves and straights all sharing a single width. And Basic, a sans-serif that only gently lifts capitals above small letters, gives that loudness somewhere quiet to land.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-cal-sans: Cal Sans runs one stroke width through the whole alphabet, with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Cal Sans keeps a page of text moving at a friendly, modern pace, well away from Luckiest Guy's shouting.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-carlito: Carlito is plain sans with round, open letters that stay readable small and thread-tight spacing. Carlito does the small, careful reading, while Luckiest Guy, with strokes as constant as bent wire, does the cheering.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-changa: Changa reads modern and clean, its lowercase carrying the stature of cast iron capitals. And since that lowercase already stands so tall, Changa can drop a size while Luckiest Guy stays cheerful and loud.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-epunda-sans: Professional in manner, Epunda Sans opens its curves with plenty of daylight inside and trims the sidebearings thin. Epunda Sans carries paragraph after paragraph smoothly, a world away from the loud cheer of Luckiest Guy.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-farro: Farro reads approachable, plain sans with short ascenders and no stroke contrast at all. Luckiest Guy does the loud, cheerful grabbing, and Farro does the steady explaining once attention has landed.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-genos: Contemporary and tightly set, Genos presses its glyphs so close their edges almost kiss. Genos trims its crossbars a bit finer than the stems, where Luckiest Guy gives bars and stems identical heft.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-geom: Luckiest Guy is cheerful and loud, with a high-set mean line and a rope-like consistency in every stem, bowl and tail. Geom, a sans with a lofty lowercase, gives it room to breathe.
